# Woods Run Digest

> Daily forestry and forest-products intelligence from The Forest Business School.

Woods Run Digest publishes a daily briefing for people working in forestry and forest products. Coverage includes timber sales, stumpage and delivered wood, logging and trucking, sawmills, pulp and paper, biomass, forest-products markets, mill investment and capacity, procurement, equipment, forest business, grants and opportunities, and new forestry publications, datasets and tools.

## Primary pages
- Latest edition: https://woodsrun.forestenterprise.org/
- Archive: https://woodsrun.forestenterprise.org/archive/
- Research and publications: https://woodsrun.forestenterprise.org/research/
- Sitemap: https://woodsrun.forestenterprise.org/sitemap.xml
- The Forest Business School: https://www.forestenterprise.org/

## Editorial notes
Issues are prepared from public sources and link to original material. Woods Run Digest favors specific operational and business information over generic news aggregation.
